alternatives.mechanism: Encrypted local database with scheduled automatic backups to a user‑controlled external encrypted drive
addresses_issues: Data stored only locally is vulnerable to loss, theft, or malware infection
Absence of automatic backup or synchronization increases risk of irreversible data loss
tradeoffs: User must remember to keep the external drive available and secure
Backup process may be slower on large datasets
Additional setup complexity for encryption keys
alternatives.novelty_or_difference: Combines strong local encryption with offline physical backup, keeping data out of any network

alternatives.mechanism: Peer‑to‑peer encrypted sync layer that replicates the health database across the user’s own devices (desktop, laptop, phone) via local network, without any cloud server
addresses_issues: Data stored only locally is vulnerable to loss, theft, or malware infection
Absence of automatic backup or synchronization increases risk of irreversible data loss
Assuming the user can manually input and maintain structured health data accurately
tradeoffs: Requires at least two devices and proper network configuration
Local network traffic could be intercepted if not properly encrypted
alternatives.novelty_or_difference: Leverages user‑owned devices as a distributed backup, eliminating reliance on third‑party cloud

alternatives.mechanism: Embedded on‑device AI module that offers guided data entry forms, auto‑completion, and real‑time pattern detection using pre‑trained, privacy‑preserving machine‑learning models
addresses_issues: Relying on simple tools for pattern detection may be insufficient for clinically relevant insights
Assuming the user can manually input and maintain structured health data accurately
tradeoffs: Increases application size and CPU usage
Model updates require manual download or reinstall
AI suggestions may produce false positives/negatives
alternatives.novelty_or_difference: Adds intelligent assistance while keeping all computation and data strictly on the user’s hardware
